# HIDAN Project Notes

- This is a dependency-free, single-page browser app. The implementation lives in `index.html`.
- Keep targets synthetic and all practice logic inside this app. Do not add game integration, screen capture, process access, or external input automation.
- Preserve the responsive dark-green/lime visual identity and keyboard accessibility.
- Validate UI changes by opening `index.html` in a browser and checking session start/pause, drill selection, scoring, and mobile layout.
- Personal bests are stored locally per drill; avoid collecting or transmitting user data.
